notes: Both ἕως πότε pairs are analysed alike as single aligned units on 'how long', headed on πότε and 'how'; rule 64 cites Ἕως πότε → how long as a unit of that shape, and rule 24 requires the two occurrences to match. Splitting 'how' from 'long' across the tokens remains defensible.

'bear with you' gives 'with' to the genitive object ὑμῶν, the ASV having written a verb word of its own for the compound ἀνέχομαι (rule 106); the expressed μετά earlier in the verse takes its own 'with' under rule 36.
The vocative γενεά and its adjectives are split per token though the ASV reorders them (rule 26); Ὦ is the expressed interjection and no article stands, so rule 89 is not in play.
